decision: Freeze all nonessential expansion work for first viable high-quality voice-room beta; manual Owner/agent/host agency cash and monthly payroll actions handled in protected admin dashboard. Preserve design, existing source and historical task statuses.
do_not_do: Do not modify or delete approved UI assets, room visuals, VIP frames, 15 seats, music/gift button layout without Owner decision.
Do not build APK or AAB before existing T48 gates, both 80% measures and explicit Owner approval.
Do not push ten pending migrations to production, invent real-backup evidence, or enable paid plans without consent.
Do not credit fake wallets, automate external cash acceptance, or zero diamonds before an immutable audited entitlement snapshot.
Do not split ledger/account authority between Supabase and Firebase.
Do not claim frozen visible buttons work if no real backend; obtain Owner decision and ensure honest accessible release presentation.
core_stack: Supabase Auth/PostgreSQL as source of truth for users, rooms, moderation, coins, diamonds, agency relationships and financial ledger.
LiveKit/SFU/TURN for real tested two-phone audio; must be configured and measured under free quota.
Minimal Firebase Crashlytics/FCM only if integration solves a measured beta need and is free; Firebase not another financial database.
Cloudflare Pages for site, GitHub Releases for approved APK after gates, GitHub Actions for CI.
Email SMTP with an approved no-cost provider, uptime/error monitoring and separate backup/restore proof.

human_approvals.recharge: Customer sends request. Outside-app cash is checked manually by responsible agent or authorized management. Agent/Owner verifies receipt, then protected RPC atomically credits exactly once with unique receipt reference, audit and ledger.
human_approvals.owner_treasury: Only Owner issues coins against externally verified cash reference; Owner manually allocates coins to approved recharge agents with atomic balanced ledgers.
human_approvals.host_agencies: Customer service receives host-agency applications. Only Owner and designated main-partner Super Admin can enter full host-agency-management and approve/manage it; a DB employee may only use the narrowly delegated host-agency-opening workflow where explicitly authorized, without full management access and never opening recharge agencies.
human_approvals.host_transfer: Old host agent consent and new-agent acceptance required; Owner/designated partner can investigate unfair refusal, ignored requests or closed agency and exceptionally authorize transfer with evidence.
human_approvals.monthly_close: Staff prepare month-end agency/host diamond totals, targets, rates, salaries and liabilities manually. Protected admin workflow freezes immutable ledger/snapshot before any operational diamond clearing, requires authorized approval with retry/idempotency and audit, prevents duplicate close and preserves unpaid entitlements permanently; manual external payout is reconciled separately.
human_approvals.support: Support agents handle tickets and issues manually under scoped roles; operations auditable; no staff may self-grant Owner or partner authority.

beta_release_non_negotiables: Real authenticated users, reset/recovery, no demo financial data
Real two-phone room audio with mic seat/moderation and reconnection
15-seat designed room UI, chat, gift selection-before-send and audited wallet
Manual recharge agent and Owner approval with unique cash reference and balanced immutable ledgers
Host agency/customer support workflows, permission isolation and documented exceptional transfers
Month-end manually approved immutable entitlement snapshot and no-loss diamond operational reset if operational diamond clearing is enabled
Admin dashboard functions actually wired, no dead / pretend controls for beta participants
Encrypted offsite production database AND Storage object backup independently restored, hosted staging and safe migration replay
No critical privacy/security/account/financial bugs, stable Android device tests
T48 gate unchanged: engineering>=80, beta>=80, 40/50 verified_live, nine evidence checks passed, reviewer + Owner APPROVED
note: Task beta_30d_scope is a prioritization decision, not completion proof. The formal T48 40/50 live-verified gate remains binding; 7 paused tasks leave 43 candidate tasks, but task-level acceptance must be evidenced and cannot be fabricated.
